reason: I already have a GitHub Action that runs claude -p overnight and opens PRs. Drawing flows and pairing a Host feels like more setup than adding twenty lines of YAML to what I have.
objection: It is pre-alpha from one developer, and I would be swapping a script I fully control for a tool that might stall or vanish.
would_change_my_mind: If my script started falling over on retries and approval steps, and I could import it into Night Shift in an afternoon without running a Host.
